mapper.select: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = current_schema() and table_name = #{tableName} and table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
select * from information_schema.columns where table_schema = current_schema() and table_name = #{tableName} order by ordinal_position

select tables.table_name, obj_description((quote_ident(tables.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(tables.table_name))::regclass) as table_comment, t_code_generator_config.update_time configTime from information_schema.tables tables left join t_code_generator_config on tables.table_name = t_code_generator_config.table_name where tables.table_schema = current_schema() and tables.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
AND tables.table_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryForm.tableNameKeywords}, '%')
